summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, a social hub, lore destinations and a solo tutorial. Shared player behaviors and place simulations compose authored and generated spaces; NPCs, creatures, dialogue, loot and quests supply encounters and progression.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0/Lobby maze; sim lays ecology, routes, landmark moments and seeded Tripo office/hall/arch dressing alongside Level 0.2, Zenith entry, Christmas Area, Manila Room and stair anomalies.

places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with authored shops/escalators and simulated staff; concourse now includes a juice bar, kiddie ride, photo booth and mall directory, alongside the gallery, arcade and Rico's platform/Bonus Line routines.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial route.
places/level01 (3D) - Zenith Station: station, breach, doors, bots, hazards and recorder quest.

places/level1, level2, level02, level21, level3, gamma (3D) - Habitable Zone/M.E.G. camp, Pipe Dreams, Level 0.2, Locked, Electrical Station and Base Gamma; local sims own specialized environments and routes.
places/level4, level5, level6, level7, level10, level26, level27 (3D) - Office, Hotel, drowned house, sea/Fort Surrender and Tiny, Bumper Crop farm/outpost and lake, and deeper destinations.

places/level11 (3D) - Infinite City with generated street grid/subway and authored street furniture; sim adds Spamton's brick-bounded alley, payphone/trash cans and commuter faceling, and owns city cast and destinations.

places/level12, places/level13, places/testlab, places/spamton (3D) - Matrix-to-Boiling-Frogs destinations, Floor 283, and authored test/bonus spaces; places/level184 is another standalone simulated destination.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input mappings; world.config.yaml also selects shared lighting.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and generated/ticked simulation.
scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title, creation, arrival and tutorial routing.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player state/actions, aiming camera and third-person toggle.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/xmas-room.js - Level 0 layout, Christmas Area pocket and stair-anomaly seeding.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/level0-moments.js + scripts/moments.js - seeded Level 0 story spaces and usable-object handlers; versioned Tripo cubicle/cooler/wet-floor-sign dressing.
places/level02/sim.js + scripts/lib/level02.js + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js + scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - Level 0.2 house, crew exit, basement grid/collapse and Fresh Paint.
mods/lagscope/mod.json + watch.js + panel.js - attach-to-player performance sampling and F3/god-rail inspector in any game with the mod installed.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/data/preload.yml + scripts/lib/preload-next.js - solo room IDs/names, destinations and door/model proximity-preload manifest; Level 11 street set included for warm-up.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/data/weapons.yml - common loot, containers, item definitions, rarity and weapon variants.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js - parametric door geometry/motion and deterministic Level 3 paired wall-hatch layout; thresholds/sign geometry is shared by participating places.

scripts/lib/quest-route.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js + scripts/lib/quests.js - crossing graph/objectives and common quest state; dialogue.js/dlg-*.yml author NPC conversations and npc-starters.js supplies quest/realty choices.
scripts/lib/data/l02-props.yml + scripts/lib/data/l02-remodel.yml + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js - Level 0.2 prop catalog, shifting partitions, lamp/paint configuration, crew dressing and reset.
scripts/lib/breakables.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml - shared prop/wall material, damage, drops, wrecking and regrowth; place sims opt in with sweepProps/tickWalls.
scripts/lib/data/cow-lines.yml + art/vo/act.py + scripts/lib/data/voice-acted.yml/voices.js - per-cast gunpoint reaction lines and recorded takes consumed by scripts/lib/meg-agent.js.
scripts/lighting.js - world.config.yaml's shared surface shader; applies PBR lighting plus world-space soft wear noise to all lit surfaces.
notableExports: scripts/lib/xmas-room.js - layXmas, stillLook; scripts/lib/maze.js - XMAS_CELL and maze cell/zone helpers; scripts/xmas-geo.js - geometry(ctx); scripts/xmas-still.js - update(ctx).
scripts/lib/musicbox.js - MB, MB_LOOP, MB_WIND, MB_BODY, kneel, placeMusicBox, musicNear; scripts/musicbox.js - update, ears.

scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js - CAT_BODY, CAT_OLD, CAT_BODY2, paintOf, skinParams, EYE_COLORS, SHADOWS, faceLife, catModel, chestOf, SNOUTS, catMorph; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - shared NPC appearance/refitting exports.
scripts/lib/items.js - itemsOf, tokenOf, describe, MEAT, CASH and money; shared item tokens are consumed by interaction, loot UI and player inventory.

scripts/door-geo.js - geometry, collider; scripts/lib/thresholds.js - dressThresholds; scripts/threshold-geo.js - threshold geometry/material builders; scripts/lib/level0-moments.js - wallPose, layMoments.

scripts/lib/quest-route.js - nextQuestExit; scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - questMark; scripts/lib/quests.js - MAX_TRACK, TINT, PLACE_NAMES, qid, setQuest, endQuest, tracked, toggleTrack; scripts/lib/voices.js - voiceKey, actedVoice, vo.

scripts/lib/breakables.js - classOf, strFactor, wallProtected, wallKeyAt, brokenList, syncLevel0, gridWallAt, syncWalls, sweepProps, tickWalls, toolOf, rollDrops; scripts/lib/sign-style.js - restyleSigns.

scripts/lib/fp-gun.js - FP_GUN, firstPersonGun, firstPersonTuning; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel; weapon presentation helpers are consumed by scripts/player.js and the viewmodel behavior.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved position, tapes and currency cents; car purchases are recorded as vehicle IDs in player.state.cars.
scripts/lib/quests.js - player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; quest handlers own quest-specific state; dina-quest.js owns dinaQ, dinaDiary, dcut and seeds the-way-back.
scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - player.state.remodQ, l02got, l02paint, fresh, capnAsk and capnFailed plus Fresh Paint quest/HUD/payout/reputation.

scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js own kick cooldowns and carry/held target session; scripts/lib/loose.js + breakables.js own loose prop/wreck and breakable state, including place.state.gone and wall breakage/timestamps.

Enemy managers own AI and sneakTarget; scripts/lib/meg-agent.js keeps gunpoint reaction memory, dialogue and pose on NPCs; scripts/lib/critter-model.js builds/refits appearance from wear/look data; scripts/lib/l7-tiny.js owns Tiny hunt/movement state.

places/level02/sim.js owns phase/caseLandAt and reset markers; scripts/lib/l02-grid.js writes place.state.l02grid.layout; scripts/lib/l02-use.js writes its lamps map; Level 0.2 sim repairs missing grid/crew dressing roots without replacing persisted layout.

places/main/sim.js owns momentsV=13/moments, stairsSeeded and dressV=DR.v (currently 2); scripts/lib/xmas-room.js owns place.state.xmasV and generated xmas-prefixed landmarks; xmas-still.js keeps behavior/combat fields on its objects.

places/level1/sim.js owns place.state deck build phase/l1Deck markers; places/level11/sim.js owns l11CastV/l11CastBusy refit migration, city build version/cursor and selected walker placement; scripts/l11-crawlers.js manages foe state.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb, interact, grab/kick, build, inventory, combat, social, hub, camera and quest behaviors.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera; camera writes aimPt/aimPitch → player.js ballistics and weaponAim; player.js zoneHere → scripts/lib/maze.js zone names.
world.config.yaml input actions bind kick H/L and reload R; drink and compass actions have no explicit key bindings here; handlers in player/combat behaviors consume action names.
scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js solo room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to hub/home and maintain roomHop/save-place state; Bonus Line boarding is separate.

Fresh visit → main-menu.js; START routes to intake or Bonus, wardrobe close to intro/tutorial0; menuOpen drives menu UI and solo pause scales place time; title music is suppressed in places/bonus for its own mall track.
places/main/sim.js cadence → layXmas(ctx) → scripts/lib/data/xmas.yml + scripts/xmas-geo.js populate the north-rim Christmas pocket; xmas.yml bounds also let player.js suppress Level 0 hum.

xmas-room.js attaches scripts/xmas-still.js to Still Lifes, Lamp Sitter, Watcher and Red Stray → role-specific movement/combat and searchable container state; Christmas loot flows into player inventory and crafting.
scripts/lib/data/craft.yml + scripts/lib/craft.js → Bobette and Carolynne recipes; weapons.yml, weapon-look.js, vmpose.js and art/weapons/fit.json define combat weapon variants and presentation.

places/main/sim.js → scripts/lib/level0-moments.js lays seeded story graffiti/landmarks → scripts/moments.js handles usable stair objects and transfers the interacting player between outside and downstairs.

places/main/sim.js imports scripts/lib/data/l0-dress.yml → DR models/sizes/counts place Tripo partitions, wall-facing coolers and wet-floor signs; a DR.v change clears/re-lays tagged l0dress props and updates place.state.dressV.
places/level02/sim.js detects absent l02-gw-v1-0 or l02-gd-cloth0 roots → layGrid(ctx) restores basement grid/crew dressing while retaining persisted layout.

scripts/player.js uses musicbox token → scripts/lib/musicbox.js places a wind-up box after rest cooldown, kneels and starts audio/effects → scripts/musicbox.js winds down and E pickup restores the token; musicNear queries within range.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + mall sims/shopper/salon scripts - authored mall shops and props plus simulated staff; concourse retail and directory assets are scene placements, while Rico's platform schedule and Bonus Line boarding remain separate cooperating routines.
scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction scripts - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild flow.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js and prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage parts with eased motion and legacy prop migration; Fort Surrender uses tagged paired leaves.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js + participating place sims, alongside sign-style.js/sign-geo.js - shared crossing clues and per-place/per-id sign-board styles.

places/level01/sim.js + Zenith geometry, breach, hatch, bot and hazard scripts - Zenith Station environment and interactive systems; places/level02/sim.js + l02-grid.js vary basement partitions, lights, crew, knocks and reset, and restore persisted layouts.

scripts/lib/meg-agent.js - per-NPC nerve/stats/weapon-driven reactions, aim, cover and recorded gunpoint barks; scripts/lib/critter-model.js refits NPC bodies across Level 7, Bonus and Level 0.2 and maps facelings to regular skin-toned body variants.
Level 13: level13-furnish.js + level13.yml vary flat furnishing/story; level13-dress.js + l13-dress.yml lay hall traces/doors; foe, people and tape layers define encounters/residents/salvage.

Level 0: places/main/sim.js versions scripts/lib/level0-moments.js seeded wall messages and scripts/lib/data/l0-dress.yml Tripo partitions/coolers/signs; DR.v migration replaces tagged dressing, with moment handwriting seeded separately.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js, scripts/lib/debug-layout.js - debug-room pads/layout after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Threshold dressing version is V=7 in scripts/lib/thresholds.js; preserve thrSeen/thrTry/thrDone/thrV and door transfers' local #-marked xferTo/carryId rules; Level 3 hatchV=3 rebuilds l3-hatch-* deterministically.

Level 0.2 sim V=25 rebuilds generated roots; preserve phase/caseLandAt and debris tags, plus the 15-second empty reset. Grid state remains place.state.l02grid={layout, lamps}; walls swap on six-second passes with view/near/lamp exclusions.

Christmas Area scripts/lib/data/xmas.yml v=9 re-lays xmas-prefixed objects; keep maze.js XMAS_CELL and xmas.yml cell/bounds aligned (bounds suppress Level 0 hum); retain top-level player.state baubles/stuffing for craft recipes.

Breakables use scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml material tuning; sweepProps infers only eligible small, unparented, non-NPC/non-usable props by ID and skips structural IDs; wall/prop wreck records and regrowth are shared across place sims.

Level 0 moments migration is places/main/sim.js momentsV=13: old moment-tagged pieces are cleared (with legacy almond cleanup) before layMoments; preserve the mandatory moment tag. Tripo dressing reads DR.v (currently 2) and clears/re-lays tagged l0dress props.

First-person viewmodel tune values in player.state.vmTune now apply only when vmTune.weapon matches the equipped weapon (default fists); fp-gun.js, player.js and vmpose.js share this filter. Level 0 baseboard color is now pale cream in level0-geo.js.
